tone_patterns: Neutral, compliance-oriented tone focused on describing processes, methodologies, and metric definitions rather than persuasive narrative
Uses precise, technical vocabulary aligned to sustainability reporting standards (e.g., risk management, methodology, exposure, financed emissions)
Balances qualitative descriptions (approach/policy) with quantitative disclosures (values, counts, percentages) in a structured format
Uses cautious phrasing for incomplete items (e.g., indicating work-in-progress or not reported for the period) without over-explaining
paragraph_patterns: Short explanatory paragraphs used inside table cells to describe an approach, policy, or methodology
Process descriptions often follow a sequence: governance/process setup → data inputs/sources → analysis steps → outputs/uses in decision-making
Where relevant, paragraphs include examples of factors considered (listed inline) to clarify scope of assessment
Multi-paragraph cell content used for longer methodologies, separated by line breaks to improve readability within a table
heading_patterns: Section title presented as a running footer/header label on each page (repeating the section name)
Table column headers are concise noun phrases (e.g., metric name, definition, value, source, mapping) and repeat consistently across pages
Uses standard/framework labels as categorical anchors (e.g., mapping to report section; standard references) rather than narrative subheadings
table_patterns: Primary disclosure vehicle is a multi-page table with a fixed column structure repeated on each page

Columns include: Metric (short label), Metric Definition (long-form definition), Reporting-period Value (numeric or narrative), Source (standard/framework), Source (internal document/report), Mapping to Report Section (cross-reference)
Table supports mixed data types: numeric values, percentages, zeros, 'not included/not reported' statements, and qualitative descriptions
Long definitions and methodologies are embedded directly in cells; line breaks and indentation are used to maintain legibility
Lists within cells use numbered bullets for procedural items and simple line-separated lists for categories/industries
For complex metrics, the definition cell includes sub-parts (e.g., (1), (2), (3)) and the value cell mirrors that structure
Disaggregation tables appear within a larger table cell (nested tabular layout) to present category-by-category breakdowns with totals
Totals are explicitly shown as a final row in breakdowns to reinforce completeness
Symbols/markers (e.g., a delta) are appended to specific values to indicate assurance status, with an explanatory footnote
figure_or_diagram_patterns: No standalone charts/figures in the excerpt; complex quantitative disclosures are handled via tabular breakdowns rather than graphics
Where methodology is referenced, the report points to an external location (e.g., website) instead of embedding a diagram
pdf_layout_patterns: Multi-page table continues across consecutive pages with repeated column headers at the top of each page
Page footer includes: section label, page number, and report title line; consistent placement across pages
Dense tabular layout with controlled line wrapping to fit long text within columns
Use of typographic hierarchy: bold/strong emphasis for column headers; regular text for cell content; smaller footnote text for assurance notes
Footnote block placed at the bottom of the final page of the table segment, separated from the table body and spanning the page width
Assurance marker symbol is visually tied to specific metrics/values and explained once in a consolidated note
disclosure_language_patterns: Metric definitions use standard-like phrasing: 'Description of approach to…', 'Number of…', 'Total amount of…', 'Percentage of…', 'Methodology used to…'
Where items are not available, uses a clear status statement (e.g., not included for the reporting year) rather than leaving blanks
Cross-references to standards and internal sources are explicit and consistently placed in dedicated columns
Methodology disclosures may be satisfied via a reference to an externally published methodology document, stated succinctly
evidence_presentation_patterns: Evidence is presented through traceability fields: external standard reference, internal source document, and mapping to report section
Assurance status is indicated at the data-point level via a symbol, supported by a consolidated assurance note describing scope and standards used
Quantitative breakdowns provide both absolute values and relative percentages to support interpretability
Uses explicit zeros for certain metrics to avoid ambiguity
section_specific_observations: The section functions as an index-like repository of metrics with definitions, values, and traceability rather than narrative discussion
Combines general ESG process metrics (policies/approaches) with climate-related metrics (exposure/financed emissions) in the same standardized table format
Includes both mandatory-style disclosures and entity-specific process descriptions, unified through consistent table scaffolding
Assurance disclosure is appended as a standardized note applicable to marked items within the table
things_to_avoid_copying: Any organization names, business unit names, product/service names, or references to specific third-party providers
Any numeric values, percentages, currency amounts, totals, or year-specific statements
Any jurisdictional/regulatory references tied to a specific country or regulator
Any assurance provider identity or specific assurance standards citations as fixed text (retain only the pattern of describing assurance scope and basis)
Any specific industry exposure breakdown categories or sector lists as-is (only reuse the concept of disaggregation)
content_specific_items_detected_and_excl: Company and group names and abbreviations
Named third-party data vendors and service providers
Specific internal documents/packages referenced as sources
Specific regulatory program names and stress test labels
All reported counts, percentages, currency-denominated exposures, emissions totals, and year references
Specific industry/sector breakdown list and ordering
Named assurance firm and detailed assurance standard identifiers
